title: AOS must use FIPS 140-2/140-3 approved algorithms for authentication to a cryptographic module.
check_content:
Verify the AOS configuration with the following command: 
show fips 
 
If "FIPS settings: Mode Enabled" is not returned, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Configure AOS with the following commands: 
configure terminal 
fips enable 
write memory 
reload
VulnDiscussion:
Unapproved mechanisms that are used for authentication to the cryptographic module are not validated and therefore cannot be relied on to provide confidentiality or integrity, and DOD data may be compromised. 
 
Network devices using encryption are required to use FIPS-compliant mechanisms for authenticating to cryptographic modules. 
 
FIPS 140-2/140-3 is the current standard for validating that mechanisms used to access cryptographic modules use authentication that meets DOD requirements. However, authentication algorithms must configure security processes to use only authentication algorithms that are FIPS-approved and recommended by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

Satisfies: SRG-APP-000179-NDM-000265, SRG-APP-000224-NDM-000270, SRG-APP-000411-NDM-000330, SRG-APP-000412-NDM-000331
